rules.statement: A person having a claim in respect of a lease at will or for a period not exceeding one month is not a necessary party to a Partition action.
rules.supporting_quote: It was further held that a person having a claim in respect of a lease at will or for a period not exceeding one month, is not a necessary party to a Partition action.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance
